comment: Dr. Jonas is an outstanding leader, great professor, even better human being. He always took time to get to know his students, and wanted the best for them. One of the few (if not the only one at UR) who could connect and relate with the academics and the athletes! I hope he will one day consider coming back to UR as our next University President!

I wish he was my Grandpa, seriously. Four papers, but easy topics.He also grades very fairly.He used to be in the military and has interesting perspectives on different parts of the world.Also has japanese grandchildren so you know he's a boss!

I took Jonas for Intro to American Government.  He is fair and not hard.  The class is very manageable but can be a little boring.  Overall though, I am glad I took it.  Jonas is the man and is a great professor.

Dr. Jonas knows quite a bit about the workings of state gvn't and is a very passionate teacher.  I'd say that he is a pretty good professor as of right now, and will improve a lot with time.  If you are a fan of night classes, then Dr. J is a good professor to take.
Kirk is the man. Solid guy, classes go by fast, interesting stuff, and he has a kickin' big screen t.v. His wife makes a sick Virginia ham.

Dr. Jonas presents interesting course material to suplement his class topics. There was a 5 - 10 page paper due at every class (it was a once a week class) which was very time consuming and frustrating. Nevertheless, the class was interesting
Really nice guy.  Makes class interesting by incorporating speakers, trips, and role-playing games.  His course isn't difficult if you do the reading and go to class.  Very reasonable grader.
